notes.title: Update v5.1 Add resolution, Fix all crashes, bugs and glitches.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761941/63e3fad1de6a1d3b8dbdfca51e919c561d6d8cc2.png[/img]

[b]Update v5.1[/b]

Recent Update: Awesome Game Improvements!

First of all, we want to apologize for the delay! Our team faced some personal challenges that impacted development time, but we finally managed to resolve everything with a lot of effort and dedication. We greatly appreciate everyone's patience and understanding! 🙏

🔧 Bug Fixes
After listening to the feedback from our amazing community, we dedicated our time to fixing all the bugs that were affecting the gaming experience. We had a memory leak that caused constant crashes, but it has been completely fixed. Now, you can play more fluidly, without interruptions, and enjoy much more stable and reliable gameplay!


📏 Multiple Resolution Support
We know that every player has their preferences, and now you can adjust the game's resolution to your liking! From now on, you can choose between several resolutions, providing a more personalized and comfortable visual experience for all types of screens.


🚀 General Improvements
In addition to the fixes and new resolution options, we've made several performance improvements and graphical tweaks to optimize the game. The game is faster, with smoother transitions, and performs flawlessly on a variety of system configurations. 

We're incredibly grateful for your support and we're continuing to work to deliver the best experience possible! 💖

Finally, if you could re-review the game now that we've made these improvements, we'd be very grateful! 🙌

notes.title: Update v1.8 Fix all crashes, bugs and glitches.
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761941/63e3fad1de6a1d3b8dbdfca51e919c561d6d8cc2.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44761941/a899e1e42b6e29e0a57f2997f30c8a14cb229c7e.png[/img][/url]

[b]Update v1.8[/b]

We resolve all crashes, bugs and glitches. We also implemented returning to the last slide that was when you exited your game. We listen to your feedback. And we resolved everything that was reported.
Next update we will implement Linux version and more improvements.
